The installer contains the unmodified official USBPcap 1.5.4.0 installer:
https://github.com/desowin/usbpcap/releases/tag/1.5.4.0
USBPcap project: https://desowin.org/usbpcap/
Copyright (c) 2013-2020 Tomasz Mon and upstream contributors.

USBPcap's kernel driver is licensed under GNU GPL version 2; USBPcapCMD and
the shared protocol header are BSD-2-Clause. Full license texts are beside
this notice. The original C++ remapper communicates with the installed
driver using its public IOCTL and capture formats; it does not link or
incorporate the GPL driver implementation.

Complete corresponding upstream source for the exact bundled release is
included as usbpcap-src-incl-pdb-1.5.4.0.7z. Keep this source archive and
these license texts with every redistribution of our installer or extracted
package. The archive includes the upstream build/installer source and PDBs.
Our installer installs this archive beside the application; no separate
network request or source offer is needed to obtain it.
